item.title: ICE activity is surging ahead of midterms. So is voter turnout.
item.description: Across the country, there are reports of heightened ICE activity. Advocates worry about how close it is to midterms, but so far voter turnout is surging.

item.title: NPR special: 5 takeaways from a year of listening to swing voters
item.description: Every election, there is a crucial sliver of voters who help determine which candidates win. Here are five takeaways from a year of listening to voters who backed Biden in 2020 and then Trump in 2024.

item.title: Binance flags 'potential security issue,' says approximately $6.3 billion impacted
item.description: It wasn't immediately clear the extent of the damage hackers might have been able to cause, and Binance had not explicitly confirmed that funds had been pilfered. The company said its teams are "working around the clock" to resolve the issue.
